headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Boston Red Sox 8-4, and the Chicago White Sox edged out the Detroit Tigers in a pair of games, winning 9-5 and 4-3.

Injuries continue to impact teams, with Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels) placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (Toronto Blue Jays) is out with a concussion, and Abner Uribe (Milwaukee Brewers) has been sidelined with a right forearm flexor strain. Other notable injuries include Colt Emerson (Seattle Mariners) with left wrist tendon inflammation, Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox) with a right middle finger blister, Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants) with an abdominal strain, Trevor McDonald (San Francisco Giants) with a right elbow strain, and Garrett Whitlock (Boston Red Sox) with right elbow inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including Jonathan Ornelas being traded from the Athletics to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, and the Kansas City Royals received Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, securing their win behind a strong pitching performance. Chase Burns led the way with 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 4 H. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the offense. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk and Andrew Benintendi were among the key contributors for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by strong performances from multiple players. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto all made significant impacts at the plate.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added infield depth with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash.
